title: Tested fal Idol Max Turbo on a 2D character. The rig cost 12.5¢.
author: doomunited
selftext:
This started as a 2D sprite from a project I’m working on. Codex used ImageGen to make a cleaner reference, then ran it through Idol Max Turbo on fal. It came back with a textured character, a 52-bone rig, and idle, walk, run, and jump animations.



The walk came straight from Idol. For the typing scene, Codex built the chair, desk, and computer in Blender and wrote the Python to animate the hands. The process photos show the sprite, the rig, and the finger bones over the keyboard. My favorite detail is the text popping up on the monitor as the character types.
